prompts.scene:
Edit the supplied Magic Mail Events mockup, keeping its appealing polished CARTOON style and the same Courier and Owl identities, but redesign into a coherent illustration-only production background, portrait 2:3 (1024x1536). Remove ALL UI, header, footer, lettering, buttons, icons. Artwork fills entire frame edge-to-edge. NO TEXT.
A small purple postal theater is waiting for its next delivery events. A very large but clearly recognizable actual cream MAIL ENVELOPE rests horizontally at a slight upward diagonal ON TOP OF a low broad stack of purple postal parcels (not standing on ground like a doorway). Its large triangular flap is hinged along its TOP long edge and lifted up naturally. Its front is an unbroken cream surface with purple corner accents, no ribbon obstructing the opening, no seals holding an open flap closed, no door hinges, no handles, no impossible paper geometry. The inside opening is a shallow, clearly visible golden horizontal slot behind the front rim. The center of that slot is approximately x=.51,y=.46 from top of picture, with EMPTY clean purple space immediately above for separately animated floating envelopes. No floating letters painted in the image.
Our lanky orange-haired young MALE Courier in purple envelope-badged cap, bright red coat, teal scarf, ivory gloves, navy pants, chunky brown boots is at LEFT, half crouched beside the stack, leaning in and peeking curiously into the letter, one gloved hand on the parcel stack and other hand shading his eyes in a funny exaggerated pose. His head sits x=.26,y=.40. His correct legs and both boots visible in front of the parcels. Our round cream/peach female OWL Organizer, gold glasses, huge amber eyes, peach ear tufts, plum cape, teal bow and orange bird feet is perched on a separate small parcel to the RIGHT. One wing holds the lifted flap from the right corner, the other wing points toward the Courier as if warning him not to spoil the surprise. Her head sits x=.78,y=.39. She looks amused but watchful. TWO characters only. Clear staging, believable interactions, hands/wings make sense. No human woman.
Closed purple curtain with simple gold scalloped valance behind, gold envelope badge at top center, big flat purple shadow shapes, soft lavender light patch behind the envelope. No microtexture, no 3D-realistic cloth. Keep stylization pushed: clear bold outline accents, big clean broad glossy highlights, exaggerated heads and curved comic poses, very simple chunky shapes, rich violet/plum/cream/teal/red, 2D casual mobile puzzle-game illustration. Not painterly, not realistic, not photographic or physically rendered. Expressive clear cartoon faces.
Important placement: the full character/letter composition fits within x=.13..87 and y=.22..76. The lowest 20% is quiet dark plum floor with a gentle gradient and NO decoration or objects, reserved for native title later. Top 12% valance/emblem only. Background outer edges are simple curtain that can be cropped on tall phones. A magical warm glow is painted inside the envelope slot, but no particles or letters above it; those are separate animated assets. No logos or text.
prompts.letter: Generate ONE transparent-background 2D cartoon game sprite for Magic Mail: a small chunky glossy cream postal envelope, seen from the FRONT, slight diagonal tilt, triangular closed flap visible, a shiny round purple wax seal with a tiny golden four-point magic sparkle embossed at its center. Warm golden ochre outline and shadow edge, broad clean white specular highlight upper left, cream to soft golden shading, very simple clean big readable shapes, juicy casual mobile puzzle-game art matching glossy purple/gold postal UI. Envelope width about 1.45 times height. Isolated centered complete object, generous transparent padding, no ground, no drop shadow outside the envelope, NO scene, NO text, NO multiple objects, no realistic paper grain. Actual alpha transparency. Small in-game sprite readable at 32 pixels.
